excludes: components absent from every frozen proposal
interaction_definition.one_toggle: choose a frozen proposal, then add or remove one whole Clean component
interaction_definition.toggle_pool: union of component IDs already visible in the 8 frozen proposals for that word
interaction_definition.zero_action: choose any one of 8 already-frozen proposals

interpretation_guardrails: Counts are sealed oracle ceilings, not acting-agent accuracy.
The human partition was loaded only after the proposal suite and toggle pools were frozen.
One-toggle success does not show that an agent can identify the correct component.
Unresolved words may need multiple toggles, unseen local components, splitting, or reassignment.
High quality requires precision >= 0.97 and recall >= 0.95.
